gloss: bureau chief; director; head of a department

definitions.explanation: The head of a bureau, department, or office within a government ministry, broadcasting station, or other large organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{局長|きょくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着任|ちゃくにん}→着任：14905_chakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new bureau chief took office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{局長|きょくちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with the post office director.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧{局長|きょくちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: As director of general affairs, he worked on organizational reform.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ (bureau/office/station) and {長|ちょう} (chief/head). A title used in various organizational contexts.

TYPES:
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{局長|きょくちょう}: post office director
- {放送|ほうそう}{局長|きょくちょう}: broadcasting station director
- ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧{局長|きょくちょう}: director of general affairs
- ⟦{税務|ぜいむ}→税務：30025_zeimu⟧{局長|きょくちょう}: tax bureau chief

JAPANESE ORGANIZATIONAL HIERARCHY:
In government ministries, {局長|きょくちょう} ranks below {次官|じかん} (vice-minister) and above ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧ (section chief). The hierarchy typically runs: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧ → {次官|じかん} → {局長|きょくちょう} → ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ → ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: department head — lower rank in government; equivalent level in many companies
- ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧: section chief — a more junior management position
- {所長|しょちょう}: director of an institute or office — used for research institutes, branch offices
